name: Mass Martyrdom
body:
School abjuration; Level paladin 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF (see text)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Targets one creature/level (D)
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You can link your spirit simultaneously with multiple allies, protecting each of them as if you had cast shield other. If the distance between you and any target of the spell exceeds the spell’s range, its effects are suppressed until you move closer together, at which point the effects resume. Any damage taken by the targets while out of range is not shared with you. If you die, your life force surges outward at the moment of your death back into the targets of the spell, healing 1d8 points of damage plus 1 point per level (maximum +20) to each target within range.

Each target of the spell must be carrying a holy symbol consecrated to your deity. If the holy symbol is lost or destroyed, the spell’s effect is suppressed until they can acquire or create a new one.
